headline: 64 DU students punished as AI tools used for exam cheating
summary: Students from various departments were caught using Gemini and ChatGPT to find answers during examinations, leading to cancellations and bans.
details: Dhaka University has punished 64 students across various institutes and affiliated institutions for using unfair means in examinations, including the use of artificial intelligence tools.
The university's Syndicate, chaired by Vice-Chancellor Prof ABM Obaidul Islam, decided to cancel the students' examinations and bar them from appearing in one to three subsequent exams.
In one case, a student from the Department of Mass Communication and Journalism was caught using Google's Gemini AI; two lines in his answer script matched the AI-generated text exactly.
Another student from the same department was caught using ChatGPT on a smartphone obtained from a senior student after leaving the exam hall under the pretext of using the washroom.
The punished students come from various departments, including the Arabic Department, which had the highest number of students penalized (seven).
Other affected departments include Law, English, Philosophy, and Robotics and Mechatronics Engineering, among others.
The university has seized mobile phones from the students and will return them only after they have completed their respective punishment terms.
caption:

Another student from the same department was caught using ChatGPT on a smartphone obtained from a senior student after leaving the exam hall under the pretext of using the washroom.

The punished students come from various departments, including the Arabic Department, which had the highest number of students penalized (seven).

Other affected departments include Law, English, Philosophy, and Robotics and Mechatronics Engineering, among others.

headline: 23 detained from Tejgaon College mosque over suspected militant links
summary: Dhaka Metropolitan Police conducted a drive after receiving intelligence that members of a banned militant outfit were gathering for a secret meeting.
details: Dhaka Metropolitan Police (DMP) detained 23 people from a mosque at Tejgaon College in the capital after Juma prayers today.
A team from the Tejgaon Police Station carried out the operation, detaining the individuals while they were allegedly holding a secret meeting.
A senior official of the Tejgaon Division stated that police had intelligence that members of a banned militant outfit would gather at the mosque after arriving from different parts of the city.
The official further noted that police are still working to confirm whether all 23 detainees are members of the same organization.
